text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume Sakura Chiyono O, who 
inherited the dream of the Japan Derby 
from the senior she looks up to, 
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by notable classmates like 
Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki, she 
steadily kept working hard aiming to 
conquer the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky watched over her from afar. 
Lately, she had become a rare sight in the 
Twinkle Series, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O says that standing 
alongside her and defeating her is also 
one of her goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I want to win the Derby and 
become a strong Umamusume!" With that, 
Sakura Chiyono O immediately dashed off.
